answer: Give every agent identity one ember that must be rekindled each epoch by finishing a fresh, identity-bound micro-task — a small proof-of-work puzzle seeded from its own public key and the epoch seed, so no two agents share the same task. The result is pinned to a vertex in the attestation graph, and identities that miss rekindling slip off a ledge into a probation pool that earns nothing until they re-prove. A farm of a thousand fakes must rekindle a thousand distinct embers every epoch, each costing real compute and staggered timing, while an honest agent rekindles one.
